question: Can the 2018 Korean study's 1444 甲子曆元 and 漢陽北極出地三十八度少弱 be used as direct G893 少/微 field or print-date evidence?

public_scholarly_witness.journal: 韓國史學報 / The Journal for the Studies of Korean History
public_scholarly_witness.title_cross_provider_discrepancy: KCI display heading omits 食 in 『交推步法』; KCI abstract and DBpia display use 『交食推步法』. Same DOI, author, journal, issue and page range identify ONE 2018 paper, not two editions or two sources.
observed_abstract_claims: 1444 世宗26 甲子 is a calendar-origin (曆元) choice discussed in relation to the Joseon calendar program, NOT an asserted printing year of surviving 奎貴67.
The paper discusses 李純之's 漢陽北極出地三十八度少弱 measurement as geographic polar-altitude/latitude contextual evidence.

The abstract cites prior scholarship about 世宗-era composition and subsequent 世祖-era addition of 假令/注解; the abstract's mention of 金淡 is NOT by itself a title-page collation of the later 1458/1459 physical object.

received_text_comparator.observed_passage: 先測定我國漢陽北極出地三十八度少弱，參考其二至晷影，推求得日出入之分
received_text_comparator.existing_provenance_overlap: 13PX and other earlier batches already tracked received 交食推步法序, 李純之/金石梯-悌, 1458 SNU / 1459 AKS, and original SNU G893 source images; the comparator is NOT a newly recovered original image.

dimensional_and_chronological_result.two_uses_of_shao_are_not_identified: 38度少弱 belongs to geographic 北極出地 angular elevation wording; G893 一秒八十六少 belongs to a solar 盈縮 table header. Shared 少 character across dimensions is not a demonstrated fixed conversion or original unit equivalence.
dimensional_and_chronological_result.epoch_vs_work_vs_impression: 1444 甲子曆元 (computational epoch), 1447 丁卯 (worked event year), 1458 preface/scholarly print year, and AKS 1459 publication label must remain distinct evidence-date roles.
dimensional_and_chronological_result.author_scope: 金淡 appears in the 2018 scholarly abstract's description of an earlier research interpretation, while SNU catalogue and received 1458 preface use 金石悌/梯 in their respective layers. Neither sameness nor distinctness of persons is inferred from a secondary abstract.
unsupported_inferences: KCI title omitting 食 proves a distinct historical work
38度少弱 defines solar-table 少 as 微
1444 epoch proves printed 奎貴67 was produced in 1444
the paper's abstract authenticates 1458 original 盈縮加分 folios or G893 numeric controls

next_gate: Retrieve genuinely new freely available provider-issued 奎貴67 盈縮加分 original page or source-specific G893 一秒八十六少 same-table unit/carry rule; neither scholarly secondary 38度少弱 nor KCI metadata substitutes for original glyph.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: A secondary scholarly 1444 calendar epoch is not a physical edition's printing date.
Lexical 少 in geographic polar altitude is not a proven transmitted decimal subunit of G893 solar fields.
unresolved_lineage_questions: 1458/1459 交食推步法 original-folio identity and calculation lineage
G893 native solar 少/微 arithmetic semantics and six disputed historical controls
